name: aus-visa-officer-sim
description: Simulates an Australian visa case officer reviewing a skilled or employer-sponsored visa application (subclass 189, 190, 491, 482/Skills in Demand) — either as an interactive roleplay that probes and questions the application, or as a written risk report of red flags with fixes, so the applicant can stress-test their case before lodging. Use this whenever the user wants to anticipate why an application might be approved or refused, wants to be "grilled" on their case, asks for a risk/red-flag re
